about: Scripts that write a trust-boundary path WITHOUT emitting the MEASUREMENT.md section-5 consolidated receipt, and why each is excused. Read and verified by scripts/validate/check_ratification_receipts.py at every run: an entry lapses the moment its script's sha256 changes, and a historical entry lapses unless applied_in is in history, touches the boundary path the script writes, and contains the script. No receipt is backfilled for any entry: section 5 has no backfill clause, and the operator signed what they signed. Compiled 2026-09-26 (lane/fix-ratify-checker-20260926).
